text:
Estimate for the items on the plate: 2 poached eggs, 2 slices of toast, and (in a separate bowl) blueberries. Tea is excluded.

- Eggs: 2 poached eggs, about 100 g, about 143 kcal.
- Toast: 2 slices of whole-grain toast, about 60 g, about 160 kcal.
- Blueberries: about 40 g, about 23 kcal. They are in a bowl rather than on the plate, but they are part of the meal, so I included them.

Total: about 326 kcal and about 200 g.
